rules.rule: Never fabricate bibliographic metadata, quotes, data, experiments, or results.
Separate hypothesis, interpretation, observation, experiment result, and confirmed source.
Strong novelty or causality claims require direct evidence and explicit human approval.
Search for contrary evidence and alternative explanations before finalizing the discussion.
Include limitations appropriate to the actual evidence and method.
Do not publish, submit, or send externally without human approval.
Do not expose confidential, patent-relevant, or private research material without explicit clearance.
Natural academic style is for clarity; never optimize for deceptive AI-authorship concealment.
